actual_tracking_issue.title: [AutoPerf F012] Broadcast exclusion snapshot rejected: live-input semantics
actual_tracking_issue.body:
**Rejected/design-blocked for an unvalidated per-send exclusion snapshot. No shipping optimization or performance PR; not measured comparative no-gain.**

Actual public SendAllExceptAsync repeatedly scans exclusions over the real registered connection store. A real JsonHubProtocol-serialized argument getter changes the same array/List/read-only-wrapper backing input during first serialization: one of eight actual transports receives a frame. Explicit copied-input controls passed to the unchanged broadcast owner deliver to all eight. Custom ICollection.Contains comparison/dispatch differs too. These are native producer/input-semantics controls, not an implemented indexed owner or red/green optimization. Other compatible designs remain unverified.

[Immutable runnable project, complete evidence and limitations](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/a60a43f75ab992355a1269d2789a143c4ad18a5a/F012/README.md)

## Original-only diagnostics on this box

| C128Array256 | 78244.988 | 220.982 | 8 | 316 |

| C32DupList64 | 9964.256 | 18.068 | 7 | 313 |

One independently executed original-only12-shape profile:96 raw samples,91 retained,five upper-filtered,36 warmups,223 actual overheads. Zero candidate profiles/paired comparisons; closed budget,no additional F012 timing. Different configured inputs and F011 group sends are not before/after roles. Allocation is process-wide,not isolated membership/enumerator allocation; all raw data and4.74% empty-store CV retained.

Actual public broadcast sends,real HubConnectionContext/JSON serialization,fixed256-byte synchronous per-connection transport buffers. Connections registered before timing without group creation; an untimed scope control includes an outside-group connection. Connection creation,network,handshake,stateful reconnect and typical production traffic are not measured. Actual Pipe backpressure/completion/cancellation characterized separately,untimed.

## Coverage and provenance

All27 explicitly reused original F011 DefaultHubLifetimeManagerTests rows passed:23 Facts including12 inherited specification Facts plus4 actual Theory payloads,including broadcast cancellation coverage; zero new F012 owning-suite runs,not the whole SignalR project. Original commands/timestamps/TRX retained and identical owner/test bytes rehashed. New F01217 producer checks+12 timed wrappers independently pass under both original/current JSON producers. Only JSON DLL/PDB differ across80-file images; current JSON bytes explicitly reused/rehashed from F011,not freshly rebuilt. Repository original JSON outputs unchanged; no whole-current-default integration.

Independent live and copied portable audits pass:34 producer/36 setup/36 delivery records,19 bounded PE/PDB bindings,52 selected document checks,178 source snapshots,24 unchanged settings point records. Portable mode cannot rehash omitted binaries/replay PE/PDB bindings. Both failed reader sources/observations and all raw timing/GC records retained; first audit-scaffold tool stderr not separately redirected into an artifact. No F011 group behavior/timing reused as broadcast proof.

Exact historical commands with observed exits: https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/a60a43f75ab992355a1269d2789a143c4ad18a5a/F012/validation-commands.md

Independent unchanged source branch: https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/autoperf/F012-signalr-broadcast-exclusions, baseline `37e809ead5824bc753a1c3d56f11615bdb1296c5`. Actual remote source ref and owner bytes verified.

Related David Fowler work dotnet/aspnetcore#69189 changes small-target SendConnectionsAsync,not SendAllExceptAsync; no upstream numbers reused. F011 is the separate completed group path; F013/F014 remain independent.

Shared Windows VM, SDK12.0.100-alpha.1.26557.102/runtime12.0.0-alpha.1.26562.105, settings-preserving executor; no deliberate power/priority/affinity changes or isolated-machine/general application-speedup claim.
